artworks.title: The Education of Achilles
artworks.description: Chiron teaching Achilles the lyre — the Pelion household Chariclo shares as the centaur's nymph wife and mother of Ocyrhoe. Not Chariclo mother of Tiresias.

artworks.title: Achilles and the Centaur Chiron
artworks.description: Batoni's Chiron and Achilles — the cave-school on Pelion where Chariclo stands in the Argonautica as Chiron's consort watching the heroes sail.
